notes:
Summary from procurement track and technical POC:
- Primary ask: dedicated GPU pool for production chat + high-throughput reranking. Evaluate SLA that guarantees minimum sustained throughput and bounded concurrency rather than only best-effort bursts.
- POC ran on 4xA100-equivalent nodes: observed 18k tokens/sec sustained per node on our tuned Llama-2-13B variant for streaming chat; customer requests: min sustained 75k tokens/sec across the pool (target N=5-6 nodes), p95 token emit latency targets below 120ms for small sequences.
- Concurrency: wants a hard concurrency cap per model to protect latency for chat (proposal: per-model cap 64 streams, global account concurrency 320), with ability to reserve a fraction of capacity for high-priority traffic.
- Burst policy asked: allow 2x burst for short windows (<=30s) but with throttling when sustained above 1.2x for more than 2 minutes. Legal asks for exact burst credit accounting and billing implications.
- Quantization/optimization: mature about INT8 profiles, will accept 4-bit for reranker if quality checks pass. They want Redwood Optimize recommendations tied to expected unit economics.
- Security: require VPC peering and customer-managed KMS, SOC2 evidence and quarterly audit logs export. Data residency: US-only.
- Pricing ask: committed monthly commit with step-down for overprovisioned baseline; they want an SLA credit schedule tied to missed min tokens/sec and p95 latency breaches.
- Quote asked to include: min_tokens_per_sec, guaranteed_concurrency_caps, burst_policy_definition (credits/seconds), reserved_gpu_count, fallback plan to hosted model variants if Dedicated capacity temporarily constrained.
- Quote draft shared in Drive (linked). Next call to align on SOW delta items and final GPU count estimation.
